verdict.rationale: HelixDB has no built-in natural-language interface. It enables natural-language operation indirectly: Helix Cloud exposes an official MCP endpoint with query, observability, and administration tools (helixdb-docs-24, helixdb-docs-8). `helix chef` also installs HelixDB query skills and a docs MCP so an external AI agent can scaffold and drive the database (helixdb-gh-1, helixdb-docs-17). However, the MCP query tools require exact v3 JSON requests, so the user's own agent must translate natural language into structured queries. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documented examples of NL-to-operation workflows, and hands-on or independent corroboration that agent-driven operation works well.
